name: Baxter Market
tagline: Baxter Market & Summer Lunch Trailer – Great Lakes Fresh Fish Finder
description: Baxter Market is a farmers market in 14091 Baxter Dr, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
